statement: Numbers only. The files are built in the owner's local data and are not in the repository: the segmentation's terms are not settled (rights register, R-ANATOMY-SEGMENTATION).
label: Authored construct

method.placement: Area-weighted, stratified along each zone's faces in order; each point starts at a face centre, moves to the nearest point of the pleural-space proxy and then insideProxyMm inside it; where the proxy ends in a thin edge, it goes instead to the nearest point checked to lie that far inside, one of a set just in from each proxy vertex and face centre. liftMm is how far the points moved.
